messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up 10am PT crew 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 Elliot's birthday is next Friday. Thinking of a hybrid 3pm PT micro-party so remote folks can join. Who's in for organizing? :tada:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post celebration plans in #people-ops. Use the sign-up sheet for who brings what: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bdays
Elliot: 1 Please no surprise shocking confetti bombs 89 I'm more of a low-key cake person.
Zoe: Noted. Cake over confetti. I can bring a small vegan cake and a card.
Ravi: I can do drinks (coffee + sparkling water). Quick poll: react to Sam's original message with :cake: cake, :cupcake: cupcakes, :seedling: plant, :gift: e-gift/donation.
Camila: Remote folks, if you want to send a short 5-10s clip we can play it during the call. Add your clip to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/rwd-elliot-bday
Liam: I'll be in the EU timezone that day but can join the 3pm PT call (11pm my time) for a quick 5-min hello.
Sam: Calendar invite incoming for 3pm PT quick toast (5-10 mins). If you're remote and can't make it, we'll play clips and drop a gif.
people-ops-bot: people-ops ledger: suggested per-person contribution $10-25. Sign-up updated.
Elliot: You all are too kind. Totally fine with a small cake and video clips. No need for anything big.
Zoe: Card lines? Drop here and I'll copy into a print card.
Ravi: "Happy birthday Elliot! Thanks for always stopping production chaos with a calm voice."
Camila: "Hope your next year has fewer pager surprises and more ramen nights."
Liam: "Celebrate quietly but loudly in spirit :)"
Sam: Final vote at 1:45pm PT: :cake: 8, :cupcake: 2, :seedling: 1, :gift: 3 1 cake wins. Ordering now.
Zoe: Cake ordered (small vegan chocolate) + card printed. ETA office 2:40pm.
people-ops-bot: Sign-up updated by Zoe. Last edit: 1795001299.
Camila: I'll stitch the short clips into one 45-second montage and share a link in thread when done.
Elliot: Y1 you all are the best. If anyone wants to contribute to a small donation in lieu of extra gifts, I'm happy to direct it to a local food bank.
Sam: Love that. I'll add a donation column in the sheet.
Liam: Sending a 6s clip now.
Camila: Montage uploaded: https://tinyurl.com/elliot-clip-compile
people-ops-bot: Final plan: small vegan chocolate cake, drinks, 3pm PT 10-min toast (Zoom link in calendar), montage video play, card.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Short and sweet. See you at 3pm PT (and remote folks, thanks for the clips)! :partying_face:
